B) Treat every thyroid-stimulating hormone 4.5 with high-dose T4 always
C) Central hypo high thyroid-stimulating hormone always
D) ↑thyroid-stimulating hormone normal free thyroxine; treat selectively
extreme.answer: D) ↑thyroid-stimulating hormone normal free thyroxine; treat selectively
extreme.explanation: Early thyroid failure spectrum. Therefore, the most accurate choice is: ↑thyroid-stimulating hormone normal free thyroxine; treat selectively. Benefit not universal at mild elevations.

choice_explanations.A: This alternative can appear on a thoughtful differential, but the discriminating findings align more closely with the correct choice.
choice_explanations.B: Benefit not universal at mild elevations. It is less consistent than the correct choice.
choice_explanations.C: This alternative can appear on a thoughtful differential, but the discriminating findings align more closely with the correct choice.
choice_explanations.D: Early thyroid failure spectrum. This matches the correct interpretation.
